title: LinkedIn Verified Hiring Signals input
description: Monitor public company jobs and receive new, changed, reopened, and safely confirmed closed hiring signals.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: LinkedIn company URLs, company jobs or search URLs containing f_C, numeric LinkedIn company IDs, or bare company slugs. URLs from other domains are rejected before the run starts.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Maximum jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Safety limit. A scan that reaches this limit before completeness can be proven is treated as incomplete and will never close missing jobs. Raise it only for unusually large inventories; up to 5,000 jobs are supported.

closureConfirmationScans.title: Closure confirmation scans
closureConfirmationScans.description: Number of complete consecutive scans in which a job must be absent before it is marked closed.

emitInitialSnapshot.title: Emit first-seen jobs
emitInitialSnapshot.description: Emit existing jobs as new when a company is monitored for the first time.

emitCurrentSnapshot.title: Include current open jobs
emitCurrentSnapshot.description: Also emit unchanged open jobs as current. Leave off for a changes-only feed; enable for full snapshots and health checks.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store used to preserve job history between runs.

stateNamespace.title: Watchlist namespace
stateNamespace.description: Separates independent watchlists. "auto" isolates each saved Task automatically; API callers should set a stable unique value per watchlist.

closedJobRetentionDays.title: Closed-job retention
closedJobRetentionDays.description: How long closed jobs remain in state so reopenings can be detected.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of companies scanned in parallel.

strictClosureQualityGate.title: Require 95% closure-safe coverage
strictClosureQualityGate.description: Fail the run when fewer than 95% of company inventories are fully complete. Partial output remains available, but incomplete scans never advance closure state.

verifyApplyLinks.title: Verify official apply links
verifyApplyLinks.description: Enrich new, changed, and reopened jobs with official apply URLs, status, confidence, and ghost-job risk. Results are merged into this Actor's main dataset.

strictVerificationQualityGate.title: Require 95% verification coverage
strictVerificationQualityGate.description: When verification is enabled, fail safely if fewer than 95% of submitted jobs receive a verifier result. Failed verification never commits state, webhooks, or company-scan billing, so a retry can recover the same events.

verifierActorId.title: Apply Link Verifier Actor
verifierActorId.description: Actor ID or username/name used when premium verification is enabled.

maxJobsToVerify.title: Maximum jobs to verify
maxJobsToVerify.description: Cost guardrail for official apply-link verification in one run.

verificationMaxTotalChargeUsd.title: Verification cost limit
verificationMaxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum pay-per-event charge allowed for the child verification run. The default covers up to 500 results at the current $0.004 per verified job price.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint that receives the enriched event rows after each run. Empty runs do not send a webhook.

webhookSecret.title: Webhook signing secret
webhookSecret.description: Optional secret used to sign the exact request body with HMAC-SHA256 in the x-hiring-signals-signature header.

webhookBatchSize.title: Webhook batch size
webhookBatchSize.description: Maximum event rows sent in each webhook request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy. Each company scan keeps one stable proxy session and cookie jar for reliable pagination.
